name: Leshy, Gourd
body:
GOURD LESHY
CR 5

This little plant person walks on legs like tangle vines and has a pumpkin carved with eyes and a mouth for a head. A fiery gleam in its left eye socket suggests something more dangerous than a simple jack-o’-lantern.

XP 1,600
NE Small plant (leshy)
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +2 natural, +1 size)
hp 31 (7d8)
Fort +5, Ref +4, Will +2
Immune electricity, plant traits, sonic; Resist fire 5

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee slam +8 (1d4-2)
Ranged seed +8 (1d4)
Special Attacks ensnare, seed, verdant channel 3/day (4d6)
Sorcerer Spells Known (CL 7th; concentration +10)

3rd (4/day)—fireball (DC 15), fly
2nd (7/day)—create pit (DC 14), darkness, scorching ray (DC 15)
1st (7/day)—burning hands (DC 13), charm person (DC 13), color spray (DC 13), grease, mage armor
0th (at will)—dancing lights, daze (DC 12), detect magic, flare (DC 12), mage hand, message, spark (DC 12)

Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th; concentration +10)

At-Will—tree shape (small pumpkin only)
Constant—pass without trace, speak with plants

STATISTICS

Str 6, Dex 15, Con 11, Int 10, Wis 11, Cha 15
Base Atk +5; CMB +2; CMD 15
Feats Dodge, Eschew Materials, Improved Initiative, Weapon Finesse
Skills Bluff +9, Spellcraft +7, Stealth +6 (+10 Stealth in forest), Survival +0 (+4 Survival in forest); Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth and Survival in forests
Languages Common, Druidic, Sylvan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Ensnare (Ex)

A gourd leshy’s seeds and slam attack entangle the target in vines for 2d4 rounds unless the target makes a DC 13 Reflex save. The target can attempt to burst these entangling vines before the duration expires with a DC 13 Strength check as a full-round action. The save and burst DCs are Constitution-based.

Seed (Ex)

A gourd leshy can hurl its seeds as a ranged attack. If it hits, this attack deals 1d4 point of damage (this damage is not modified by Strength) and affects the target with it’s ensnare ability. This attack has a 20-foot range increment.

Verdant Channel (Ex)

A gourd leshy can channel verdant energy to a range of 30 feet. This acts as channel positive energy, but it can only heal plant creatures and deals no damage to undead.
